name: ai-enabler
displayName: AI Enabler — machine-driven delivery from Jira
description: Takes a Jira ticket to a pull request with the machine doing the work and the human deciding at two gates. `/ai-enabler:deliver PROJ-123` reads the ticket through the Jira MCP server and runs a pipeline of dedicated subagents — ticket analyst, repo scout, solution planner, code implementer, test engineer and parallel read-only reviewers — then commits, pushes, opens the pull request and updates Jira. Each stage is also available on its own: plan, implement, test, review, ship, doctor. No spec-driven process required.
